title: Spring Pasta with Zesty Sauce
description: A simple, gluten-free pasta dish, perfect for a light lunch or dinner. This recipe combines the flavors of spring with the tanginess of zesty sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the zesty sauce over medium heat. Add the spring crostini and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly toasted.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the zesty sauce. Toss to combine.
Top the pasta with fresh parsley and parmesan cheese.
